extracted.intended_audience: members of the public and stakeholders tracking federal immigration rulemaking (regulatory commenters, attorneys, advocacy groups, agency staff)
extracted.subtask_description: An API/index page listing Federal Register documents (rules, proposed rules, interim final rules) related to immigration; the page provides titles, abstracts, publication dates, and links for many separate regulatory actions. Useful for locating individual rulemakings and the substantive regulatory changes they propose or adopt.

rubrics_metrics.name: Valid signature requirement for benefit requests
rubrics_metrics.description: If U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS) accepts a benefit request and determines later that it lacks a valid signature, USCIS may, in its discretion, reject or deny the request.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This interim final rule will clarify USCIS procedures relating to the rejection or denial of benefit requests that do not meet regulatory requirements to ensure better enforcement of signature requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fee adjustment to recover costs (Form I-246)
rubrics_metrics.description: DHS proposes to increase the fee for adjudicating Form I-246, Application for a Stay of Deportation or Removal, from $155 to $755 to recover costs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The rule proposes to adjust the Form I-246 fee to recover costs, which has not been adjusted since 1989; also proposes technical edits to the stay of deportation and removal fee regulation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Codification of H.R.1-required USCIS fees and procedures
rubrics_metrics.description: Amend USCIS regulations to codify asylum and annual asylum fees, consequences of non-payment, a new Form I-94 fee requirement, validity periods for certain employment authorization, and retention of the Form I-589 filing fee.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This interim final rule implements statutory provisions from the One Big Beautiful Bill Act (H.R.1) and specifies regulatory consequences and fee handling (including non-payment consequences and validity periods).

rubrics_metrics.name: No-fee passport exemption for qualifying first responders
rubrics_metrics.description: Implement the First Responders Passport Act by adding an additional exemption permitting the Special Issuance Agency to issue no-fee regular passports to applicants who meet the statutory criteria.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Department proposes an adjustment to the Schedule of Fees to authorize no-fee passports for eligible first responders, per statutory authority.

rubrics_metrics.name: Plain-language summary requirement for direct final rules affecting refugee resettlement
rubrics_metrics.description: The docket will include a plain language summary of the direct final rule as required by 5 U.S.C. 553(b)(4).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This rescission and regulatory streamlining action notes the requirement to include a plain-language summary in the public docket when a direct final rule is used.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prevailing wage computation methodology alignment (PERM, H-1B, H-1B1, E-3)
rubrics_metrics.description: Propose to amend regulations governing the computation of wage levels under the Department's four-tiered prevailing wage structure using OEWS wage survey data to better align prevailing wage levels with wages paid to U.S. workers similarly employed in the occupation and area.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The revision also seeks to strengthen program integrity to reduce incentives to replace U.S. workers and to ensure immigrant/nonimmigrant employment does not adversely affect U.S. workers' wages and working conditions.

rubrics_metrics.name: DV Program passport and evidence requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Require a petitioner to the Diversity Immigrant Visa Program to provide valid, unexpired passport information and to upload a scan of the biographic and signature page in the electronic entry form or otherwise indicate an exemption.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Also standardizes and amends regulatory terminology (e.g., replacing 'gender' with 'sex', using 'date of birth' instead of 'age') and adds 'shall' for clearer instruction to consular officers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mandatory electronic filing and records for OCAHO cases
rubrics_metrics.description: Implement electronic filing and records applications for all cases before the Office of the Chief Administrative Hearing Officer, including requiring certain users to file documents electronically and changing service of process methods.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The interim final rule updates practice and procedure regulations to enable and require e-filing in specified circumstances and to clarify service methods.

rubrics_metrics.name: EAD filing pauses and waiting period for asylum applicants
rubrics_metrics.description: Propose pausing acceptance of EAD applications from asylum applicants during periods when affirmative asylum average processing time exceeds 180 days, and extending the waiting period to apply for employment authorization to 365 days.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The proposed rule would change EAD application processing time requirements and add eligibility requirements; it would pause acceptance under certain system-wide processing conditions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Discretionary merits review and briefing schedules at BIA
rubrics_metrics.description: Make review of Immigration Judge decisions by the Board of Immigration Appeals discretionary (rather than mandatory) and set appropriate times for briefing in cases reviewed on the merits.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The interim final rule aims to streamline appellate review, set briefing schedules, and otherwise streamline appellate processes to reduce backlog and ensure timely adjudications.

rubrics_metrics.name: H-2B supplemental visa allocation and attestation requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Time-limited supplemental H-2B visas are available only to American businesses suffering or facing impending irreparable harm, as attested by the employer; these visas will be distributed in three allocations based on the petitioner's start date of need.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Secretary of Homeland Security, in consultation with the Secretary of Labor, exercises this authority and ties eligibility to an employer attestation of severe financial loss or impending irreparable harm.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inflation adjustment of premium processing fees
rubrics_metrics.description: Increase premium processing fees charged by USCIS to reflect inflation from June 2023 through June 2025 according to the Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers (CPI-U).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The adjustment method is specified (CPI-U for a defined period) to update fees consistent with inflation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public charge evaluation discretion and rescission of 2022 rule
rubrics_metrics.description: DHS proposes to rescind the 2022 public charge ground of inadmissibility regulations to restore broader discretion to evaluate all pertinent facts when assessing whether certain aliens are likely to become a public charge.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: DHS states the 2022 rule was overly restrictive and inconsistent with congressional intent; rescission would align with long-standing policy favoring self-reliance and broader discretion. The proposal also addresses breach and cancellation of public charge bonds.

rubrics_metrics.name: USCIS biometrics collection and use expansion
rubrics_metrics.description: Propose to require submission of biometrics by any individual, regardless of age, filing status, or association with an immigration benefit request, unless exempted; expand biometrics collection authority upon alien arrest; define 'biometrics'; codify reuse requirements; codify and expand DNA testing, use and storage; and establish an 'extraordinary circumstances' standard to excuse a failure to appear at a biometric services appointment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Also would modify how certain applicants demonstrate good moral character (VAWA self-petitioners and T nonimmigrant status applicants) and clarify biometrics collection purposes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Biometric data collection on entry and exit
rubrics_metrics.description: Amend DHS regulations to permit DHS to require all aliens to be photographed when entering or exiting the United States and to require non-exempt aliens to provide other biometrics; remove pilot program and port limitations to permit collection at airports, land ports, seaports, or any authorized point of departure.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: DHS is also requesting comments on the specific collection process as well as costs and benefits for new transportation modalities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Adjust EB-5 program fees and codify integrity requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Propose to adjust EB-5 benefit request fees and codify certain elements of the EB-5 Reform and Integrity Act of 2022 and implement new statutory requirements to provide USCIS resources necessary to accomplish the Act's goals and enhance program integrity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The fee adjustments are tied to implementation and resourcing of statutory reforms intended to enhance and maintain program integrity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Adverse Effect Wage Rate (AEWR) methodology for H-2A non-range occupations
rubrics_metrics.description: Revise methodology for determining hourly AEWRs for non-range occupations by using OEWS wage data reported for each U.S. state and territory; for most H-2A opportunities use OEWS data to establish AEWRs applicable to combined SOC codes; divide AEWRs into two skill-based categories to account for wage differentials from qualifications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Threshold determination for assigning SOC code(s) and applicable skill-based AEWR will be based on duties performed for the majority of workdays and qualifications in the employer's job offer; implement a standard adjustment factor to AEWRs to account for employer-provided housing non-monetary compensation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Diversity Visa lottery registration fee
rubrics_metrics.description: Establish a $1 fee to register for the Diversity Visa lottery program and collect the electronic registration fee at the time of registration.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This change shifts a portion of administrative costs to all registrants instead of charging only successful registrants for administering the lottery.
